definition: count of goals scored
double_counting_with: scoring_points (r=0.99, near-identity), shooting_value_raw (r=0.48)
notes: Reconciles exactly to official score (Phase 9 check 7). Not role-comparable: a goalie's goal count is zero by job description.

definition: one_point_goals*1 + two_point_goals*2
double_counting_with: goals (r=0.99), EPA_points_raw (mechanically related through shooting_value_raw)
notes: This is the PLL-points analogue of goals; correlates 0.99 with goals because two-point goals are a minority of makes.

definition: count of shot attempts / count that reached the cage
double_counting_with: shooting_value_raw (shares the same opportunity set as its denominator)
notes: Volume, not value. VIF against shooting_value_raw is 43.8 in the offensive pool -- see dependency file.

definition: goals / shots
double_counting_with: shooting_value_raw (same numerator, different baseline subtraction)
notes: Career reliability reaches 0.5 for 17.8% of shooters; single-season reliability reaches it for 6.8%. Season rate is mostly luck at typical volumes (median 9 shots/season).

definition: shots_on_goal / shots (accuracy, not finishing)
double_counting_with: shooting_pct (both draw on the same shot log; splits accuracy from conversion-once-on-goal)
notes: More identifiable than shooting_pct itself (21.4% vs 17.8% career) -- the identifiable half of finishing is hitting the cage, not beating the goalie.

definition: goals / attempts, split by shot value
double_counting_with: shooting_pct (mechanically decomposes it)
notes: Two-point conversion: observed between-player variance (0.0102) is BELOW binomial noise (0.0137) at career scope -- INDIVIDUAL_TWO_POINT_ABILITY = UNSUPPORTED / DO_NOT_USE (Phase 10 finding, re-verified in validation).

definition: share of a shooter's own attempts taken from the two-point arc
double_counting_with: two_point_conversion_pct (selection is identifiable; conversion is not -- must not be conflated)
notes: The single most identifiable rate in the project: 85.1% of career shooters clear reliability >=0.5. It is a CHOICE, not a contest outcome.

definition: PLL points / shots
double_counting_with: shooting_pct, scoring_points (both nested inside this)
notes: A volume-free rescaling of scoring_points/shots -- not an independent dimension from shooting_pct once two-point mix is fixed.

definition: PLL points from shots minus league-expected points on the same shots (residual, opportunity-baselined)
denominator: league-expected points on the same shot mix
double_counting_with: goals/scoring_points (r=0.48-0.96 depending on pool -- see dependency file), EPA_points_raw (shooting_value_raw is >=96% of offensive EPA's variance for field players)
notes: This IS the project's EGA-analogue for shooting. It is a component of EPA_points_raw, not an independent input -- summing it alongside EPA_points_raw in any composite double-counts every shot.

definition: sum of shooting_value_raw + turnover_value_raw + faceoff_value_raw + goalie_value_raw + defensive_value_partial_raw, whichever the player's role supports
double_counting_with: every one of its own components (that is its definition, not a double-count)
notes: Sums to exactly 0 across the league (verified to 1e-10 in Phase 6/7, re-verified on the canonical 2022-2026 dataset in the dependency file). This is the accounting-safe production quantity; it is NOT cross-position comparable (see CROSS_POSITION_VALUE_RESEARCH.md).

definition: turnovers committed / offensive touches / their ratio
double_counting_with: turnover_value_raw (same numerator/denominator, baselined)
notes: Career reliability reaches 0.5 for 52.0% of players -- the highest-clearing rate in the project. ~19% of league turnovers name only a team, so every player's absolute count is understated (the ratio stays internally consistent; the level does not).

definition: negative PLL points from turnovers above the position-group's per-touch rate
double_counting_with: turnovers_per_touch (same underlying quantity, baselined), EPA_points_raw (component of it)
notes: Already residualized against a position-group rate, which removes the role effect from the EXPECTATION but not from the volume: touches range 3-524.

definition: count of eligible games with a box-score row
season_award_suitability: READY as denominator, NOT as a value input
double_counting_with: EPA_points_raw at season-total scope (every season-total measure already rewards availability implicitly)
notes: Adding it as an independent input double-counts durability: every counting statistic already increases with games played. It is also the ONLY exposure denominator this feed offers for defenders, and it is crude (no minutes).

definition: shots + turnovers (a player's own), and that as a share of his team's total
double_counting_with: shots, turnovers (this IS their sum)
notes: The constant model beats every fitted usage->value model in cross-validation on 844 player-seasons (multi_season_usage_model.csv) -- usage predicts the VARIANCE of value, not its mean, in 4 of 5 seasons the correlation with offensive EPA is negative.

definition: draws taken, draws won, win rate
double_counting_with: faceoff_value_raw (same ratio, baselined against the league rate 0.49656)
notes: The most cleanly identified CONTEST-OUTCOME skill in the project: implied true between-player sd 0.148, three to seven times any other rate's. 54.4% of career takers clear reliability >=0.5.

definition: PLL points from (wins - faceoffs*league_win_rate) * possession-swing coefficient
double_counting_with: faceoff_win_pct (same quantity, scaled), ground_balls (61.5% of ground balls after a faceoff go to the faceoff winner himself -- ground-ball value is deferred specifically to avoid paying this twice)
notes: Decisive workload confound (counterfactual P5, reused below): two specialists at the identical win rate above baseline differ 2.1x in total value purely from being given more draws.

definition: count of loose-ball recoveries
season_award_suitability: UNSUPPORTED as a value input (no opportunity denominator; context-inseparable)
double_counting_with: faceoff_value_raw for faceoff specialists (61.5% overlap), caused_turnover_value for defenders (scenario E in PLAYER_VALUE_ACCOUNTING.md)
notes: Deliberately NOT valued anywhere in this project -- see PLAYER_VALUE_ACCOUNTING.md sec 4E/4F. Any future ground-ball value component must first solve the double-counting problem documented there.

definition: saves made, shots on goal faced, save rate
double_counting_with: goalie_value_raw (same ratio, baselined)
notes: Career reliability reaches 0.5 for 29.6% of goalies (8 of 27) -- the largest single improvement career pooling buys, because kappa (495 shots) is close to a full season's workload for a starter.

definition: league-expected points allowed on shots on goal faced minus points actually allowed
double_counting_with: save_pct (same quantity, baselined and point-weighted), EPA_points_raw (component of it)
notes: Counterfactual P4 (reused below) is the single strongest argument in the project against any total-value cross-position model: two goalies of IDENTICAL per-shot skill differ 30x in total value purely from team-conceded shot volume.

definition: count of turnovers the player is credited with forcing
season_award_suitability: NOT_COMPARABLE across roles; usable only as an availability-adjusted, WITHIN-ROLE partial signal
double_counting_with: defensive_value_partial_raw (same quantity, baselined against games played)
notes: Zero of 52,633 raw events across five seasons name a causing defender, a committing player, or a closest defender in a structured field -- caused turnovers survive only as a BOX-SCORE TOTAL. Correlates with games_played at rho=0.49-0.80 by season -- up to 64% of the rank variance is availability, not impact.

definition: caused turnovers above the position group's per-GAME rate (games, not defensive possessions, because no possession-exposure denominator exists)
season_award_suitability: NOT_COMPARABLE across roles, and 'partial' must never be dropped
double_counting_with: caused_turnovers (same numerator), EPA_points_raw (component of it)
notes: The word 'partial' is load-bearing: 0.0 means 'caused turnovers at the group's per-game rate, everything else unmeasured', not 'an average defender'. Pooled SD (1.74) is 4.6x smaller than goalie value's (7.98) -- evidence of measurement coverage, not of defensive unimportance.

definition: points per possession, for and against
season_award_suitability: USABLE ONLY as a concurrent-validity check, never as a player input
double_counting_with: EPA_points_raw summed by team (mechanically related -- see dependency file's team-level regression)
notes: 40 team-seasons total. A player value model must not be validated ONLY by reproducing this, because offensive EPA is a residual against the same points that determine offensive_efficiency -- the relationship is partly definitional.

definition: wins/games; scoring margin per game
season_award_suitability: USABLE ONLY as a concurrent-validity outcome variable
double_counting_with: net_efficiency (r=0.70 with win_pct in this data)
notes: The only genuine WIN outcome in the dataset. n=40 team-seasons is too small to fit more than a handful of predictors defensibly -- see the Model Family 5 regression in the dependency file.

definition: ridge-regularized two-way offense/defense rating vs the schedule actually played
double_counting_with: none (it is not currently applied to anything)
notes: PLL's schedule is a near-perfect round robin (connectivity 1.00 every season); strength-of-schedule spread is only 14-29% of team spread, and the adjustment moves ranks by 0-2 places. In 2026 its own bootstrap SE exceeds its signal.
